title: Algorithm Viewer Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Algorithm Viewer Shiny application

allow_file_uploads.description: If true, allow the user to upload their own algorithm files to view.

initial_algorithm_file.description: Path to an algorithm file to load automatically on startup. If set, initial_algorithm_id is ignored.

initial_algorithm_id.description: Key of an algorithm in the 'algorithms' map to load on startup. Ignored if initial_algorithm_file is set.

algorithms.description: Preloaded algorithms available for selection or URL-based loading. Keys are algorithm identifiers.

title.description: Human-readable display name for the algorithm.

file.description: Path to the algorithm's YAML file.

allow_algorithms_selection.description: If true, and at least one algorithm is defined in 'algorithms', display a dropdown for the user to select a preloaded algorithm.

allow_algorithm_in_url.description: If true, and algorithms are defined, allow the algorithm to be specified via the URL 'algorithm' query parameter (e.g. ?algorithm=htnport-reduced).
